cpu_metric: native plus complete-endpoint browser percent of one core; guest recorded separately
decision: Further-testing candidate only if both ms40 positions pass response/cadence gates in each profile and combined CPU mean is at least5% lower with nonoverlapping two-position ranges in each profile. Failure retains20ms. This deterministic selection gate is not a significance test. Default promotion additionally needs fidelity evidence; this trial cannot approve one.
latency_qualification: Every timely sound response uses the unchanged700ms deadline. Compare full observed ranges and retain misses. No physical speaker latency claim.
